title: UI SFX safety guide
what_it_does: sfx-analysis.md ranks Kenney sound effects by brightness, high-frequency risk and envelope, with safest picks per use (hard transition, click, reveal).
when_to_use: Choosing click and impact sounds for product-demo videos without harsh high frequencies.
why: Useful method, but it describes Kenney files; we should fetch Kenney (CC0, verify at kenney.nl) ourselves and run the same analysis rather than copy the upstream table.
